commits.message:
The playground keeps what the reader did across a rebuild; WidgetApp forwards rate (rich-animation-42lg.bp9)

/code-review high on PR #500:
- WidgetApp forwards App's rate setter, so frame rate changes live
  instead of rebuilding the app.
- Widgets and the gallery outlive a session, so typed text, scroll and
  focus survive a reduced-motion or colour-depth rebuild.
- The run starts at the terminal's own colour environment; forcing a
  depth is a step in the cycle.
- Controls take the rows they draw, so at 80 columns the readout stays.
- The scrub track draws in the cells it is given and stamps the window
  it showed on its anchor owner, so a press seeks into the window on
  screen.
- The narrow marquee holds in view under reduced motion; the marching
  ants walk clockwise by their place along the border.

The animation playground: every kind of motion on one timeline, in the card and in Node (rich-animation-42lg.bp9)

A demo under examples/animation-playground/: every kind the epic built, each
in a titled panel, with buttons to pause, reverse, scrub, change speed, step
and seek, and three preferences — reduced motion, colour depth, frame rate —
each of which rebuilds the WidgetApp over the same host, clock and timeline.
`npm run animation-playground` runs main.js in Node; the card runs the same.

One-shots replay through Animation.repeat, each turn built once; the demo's
own `cycle` combinator is gone. Playback state is the app's timeline alone.
Colour depth is a delegating TerminalHost whose env says FORCE_COLOR/NO_COLOR.

test/examples/animation-playground drives it through clicks on an xterm model
of the screen with a fake clock: every kind draws at 0, 7.3 s and near 10^6 s;
paused paints nothing; reverse and speed move the readout; the scrub bar seeks
to the cell pressed; reduced motion holds the gallery still where full motion
moves it; sixteen colours writes no 38/48;2/5 and no colour writes no colour
SGR at all.

An animation repeats: a one-shot played again every period (rich-animation-42lg.cjy) (#499)

* An animation repeats: a one-shot played again every period (rich-animation-42lg.cjy)

Animation.repeat(period, nth) is nth(n) through the nth turn, on its own
clock from 0, turns of either sign. The turn is read through the wrap a beat
and Phase.loop already use (easing.ts passAt, which beat now reads too), so
a repeat turns on the same float as a loop of its period. glyph-effects and
transitions drop their hand-written copies, one of which never reported the
cut into the previous turn when run backwards.

* Review: each repeated turn made once, -0 turn named 0, playground kit repeats through Animation.repeat (rich-animation-42lg.cjy)
